In the queued arm, call actual Service current_queued under the same contention. Require writer success under its unchanged5ms deadline, one contended callback, tick below50ms and no held source reader after tick.
Join the writer, clear the scene, shut down actual controllers and require complete Store writer acquisition after cleanup.

A pass establishes the controlled mixer/Store contention mechanism; it cannot attribute all449ms in the original workload or qualify native media quality.
